Name: Kenneth's Merry Christmas
Author: Kf29
Description:
[size=4][b]Kenneth's Merry Christmas[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]A small holiday pack with 15 Christmas tracks for the Mini-Jukebox. I wanted something that feels festive for winter, mostly warm and cozy with a couple more upbeat ones to keep it fun for the season.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Includes:[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Bedtime[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Bright[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Chimney[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Deck[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Family[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Flight[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Gifts[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Holiday[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Night[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Santa[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Sleigh[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Christmas Wish[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Cozy Christmas[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Merry Christmas[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Snowy Christmas[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]All tracks are available in the Mini-Jukebox and ready to play.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Requirements: SMAPI and Content Patcher[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Install: Drop it in your Mods folder.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Only adds new tracks, nothing is replaced. Safe to use with existing saves.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Hope it makes your winter a bit cozier.[/b][/size]

[size=4][b]Compatibility: All of my music mods are separate packs but fully compatible. You can install just one or all of them at the same time with no conflicts.[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Cartoon Capers[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Merry Christmas[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Neon Nights[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Fantasy Realms[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Haunted Nights[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]- Kenneth's Lofi Farm Beats[/b][/size]

Manifest.Description: Adds 15 Christmas tracks to Mini-Jukebox. 1.6 compatible, no vanilla replacement.
